Progress

Trophy Road

The unlock route, in one place. Earn trophies through achievements and challenges.

The starting cars and EASY tracks are available immediately. Older profiles may retain earlier unlocks; this is the current reward order.

  1. 300trophies

    COMPACT

    Compact

    Unlock the Compact: a nimble city hatch that is happy to drift. CLEAN EXIT: A clean DRIFT, one that ends without hitting a wall or spinning out, adds 1 CONTROL for a few seconds, up to 5/5.

  2. 400trophies

    MEDIUM TRACKS

    Airport · Beachfront

    Unlock the MEDIUM tracks: AIRPORT’s runway speed and apron precision, and BEACHFRONT’s ≈1.9 km of seaside sweepers around a tropical resort island.

  3. 500trophies

    AWD · TRACTION

    TRACTION

    Unlock TRACTION for AWD. Shallow off-road driving causes much less slowdown, while deep off-road remains punishing.

  4. 600trophies

    DRIFT ATTACK

    DRIFT ATTACK

    Unlock DRIFT scoring on every normal lap. Build and bank slides, set a best score for each track, and keep racing against the clock. OVERCHARGE comes with it: with BOOST full, keep drifting to build a stronger burst.

    Also unlocks the Truck’s TORQUE.

  5. 700trophies

    ADVANCED TRACKS

    Harbor · Dead Canyon

    Unlock the ADVANCED tracks: HARBOR’s switchbacks and container canyons, and DEAD CANYON’s ≈3.3 km desert run through red badlands with one tight chicane.

  6. 800trophies

    PAINTJOB

    GARAGE and cars

    Unlock body and secondary paint controls in GARAGE. Every vehicle keeps its own distinctive factory colour until then.

  7. 900trophies

    VINTAGE RACER

    Vintage Racer

    Unlock the Vintage Racer: the car for linking corners beautifully. DRIFTAGE: DRIFT drains less speed, steering becomes more aggressive and it can hold larger slip angles.

  8. 1,000trophies

    SHIFT

    SHIFT

    Unlock SHIFT for every car. Move one point away from three attributes and into the other three, then toggle between STANDARD and SHIFT while racing.

  9. 1,100trophies

    RACE CAR

    Race Car

    Unlock the Race Car: high-speed handling built for precise lines. APEX GRIP: OVERCHARGE increases CONTROL and ACCELERATION beyond their ordinary limits.

  10. 1,200trophies

    EMERGENCY!

    Fire Truck · Ambulance · Police Car

    Unlock the Fire Truck, Ambulance and Police Car. All three have maximum Boost tanks. SIRENS: Boost activates flashing emergency lights and sirens.

  11. 1,300trophies

    EXPERT TRACKS

    Midnight City · Mountain

    Unlock the EXPERT tracks: MIDNIGHT CITY’s ≈4.7 km night-time endurance lap through neon avenues, and MOUNTAIN’s ≈3.8 km alpine route over the summit, waterfall and lake bridge.

  12. 1,400trophies

    VAN · CARRY ON

    CARRY ON

    Unlock CARRY ON for Van. LOCK loses much less speed.

  13. 1,500trophies

    FLOW

    FLOW

    Unlock FLOW scoring on every normal lap. Link varied driving techniques and clever SHIFT outcomes while DRIFT and lap timing continue alongside it.

  14. 1,600trophies

    FUTURE RACER

    Future Racer

    Unlock the Future Racer: built for advanced time trials. OVERDRIVE: The longer you drive fast and clean, the higher the speed cap becomes. Leaving the track or colliding resets it.

  15. 1,700trophies

    SUV · FULL TANK

    FULL TANK

    Unlock FULL TANK for SUV. Clean driving builds BOOST TANK up to 5/5 and fills it as you go.

  16. 1,800trophies

    MONSTER

    Monster Truck

    Unlock the Monster Truck: a military-green heavyweight. OVERSIZED: Going off-road doesn’t slow it down.

  17. 1,900trophies

    SEDAN · DOUBLE SHIFT

    DOUBLE SHIFT

    Unlock DOUBLE SHIFT for Sedan. SHIFT moves 2 points between attributes instead of 1.

  18. 2,000trophies

    PERKULATOR

    PERKULATOR

    Unlock PERKULATOR in GARAGE. Install any perk you have unlocked on another car, where it runs beside that car’s own perk. LEGENDARY perks stay with their car.

  19. 2,100trophies

    RALLY RACER

    Rally Racer

    Unlock the Rally Racer: twitchy and perfect for curvy tracks. TWITCHY TURNY: DRIFT fills BOOST even faster than normal.

  20. 2,200trophies

    LEARNER CAR · GRADUATED

    GRADUATED

    Unlock GRADUATED for Learner Car. Clean driving improves CONTROL, then ACCELERATION, then TOP SPEED.

  21. 2,300trophies

    SUPERCAR

    Supercar

    Unlock the Supercar: a low, wide road-going machine with a powerful boost package. FLOW SHIFT: At FLOW ×3 or higher, SHIFT adds three attribute points without reductions. SHIFT again moves the boost to the other three attributes. Lose FLOW ×3 and the current SHIFT returns to its normal 18-point balance.
